title: Accu-Chek Guide Meter
symptom: User cannot switch the slider under 'use Bluetooth Meter' to on after connecting an Accu-Chek Guide meter via Bluetooth to a Samsung S5 mini using the latest nightly of xDrip+.
cause: The meter had never been tested and might not be supported, but later a user reported it works if paired correctly.
fix: Pair the meter and phone correctly: On the meter go to Settings > Wireless > Pairing > Pair device. On the phone open xDrip, go to Settings > Glucose Meters > Scan for Bluetooth Meter, select the meter, enter the code displayed, go back, and turn on 'Use Bluetooth Meter'. Remove existing pairings if needed. Also, xDrip might not work with the meter when Accu-Chek Connect is installed.
evidence_quote: On the meter: - "Settings" - "Wireless" - "Pairing" - "Pair device" On your phone: - Open xDrip - "Settings" - "Glucose Meters" - "Scan for Bluetooth Meter" - Select your meter - Enter the code your meter displays - Go back - Turn on "Use Bluetooth Meter"
